chapter: Buck and Bubbles: Nazarro and Bubbles
title: Bubbles asks him to teach Chuckles the new style
summary: Bubbles asks why Chuckles isn't interested in dancing and suggests Green teach him; Bubbles' mother helps while he recovers from pneumonia.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: I said, well, 'I can't understand it.' I mean he was a great dancer. I mean he's known as a great tap dancer, you know, and I told him, I said, 'In fact, he inspired me to go to tap dance, you see.' And I say, 'I'm still learning from him, you see. But I don't know. Something has happened. He don't seem to be as inspired about tap dancing as he was. I don't know.'

And he asked me 'Was it -- well, he's older than you. Maybe he can explain that, he said, but I tell you what. He said, 'Maybe my type of tap dancing he's not used to. He don't understand. But say now, if you could learn it and you would show it to him, you teach him, see, he would prefer to learn it from you than me.
'See, you all growed up together. You were children together. He says, you want to do that? I think he would

enjoy it thataway." So Mr. Bubbles was kind of sick, you see, at that time. You know, he was just getting over a bad case of pneumonia and the loss of a wisdom tooth, you know, and he was kind of convalescing, you see. He was recovering his strength, you see.
And his mother, she inspired -- she told me how to speak to Mr. Bubbles, her son. You know, his head is still (Unintelligible) -- he'll come around, you know, which I did.
